name: identity-workforce-access
objective: Prove and close Captain authentication, exact session-surface authorization, refresh concurrency, Workforce readiness convergence and native session/device isolation without local bypass truth.
truthOwner: Identity owns authentication/session/role/surface/refresh lifecycle; Workforce owns Captain profile, engagement and readiness; DSH only consumes the trusted authorized actor/readiness result.

tasks.objective: Prove one exact Identity and Workforce authorization/readiness chain
tasks.currentProblem: Static composition exists, but same-candidate evidence does not yet prove exact sessionSurface/surfaceAccess/role enforcement, Workforce public/internal convergence, provisioning, suspension and unavailable-state denial.
tasks.requiredChange: Execute current Identity, Workforce, app-captain and contract checks; reproduce mismatches across control-panel Captain provisioning, authenticated session, provider-direct Workforce read and DSH-internal readiness; repair only the authoritative owner and remove any parallel local decision.
tasks.targetState: Only the correctly provisioned Captain with an app-captain-bound live session and allowed Workforce readiness reaches DSH; every missing, wrong-kind, suspended, mismatched or unavailable state is explicit and fail-closed across all consumers.
tasks.action: Trace actor creation/activation/profile through Identity and Workforce; verify role mapping, sessionSurface, surfaceAccess and expected workforce kind; compare provider-direct and internal readiness for the same actor; add negative tests for mismatch/unavailability and rerun all affected consumers after any owner fix.
mustNotChange: Do not create a Captain-local readiness source.
Do not weaken sessionSurface, surfaceAccess, role or workforce-kind checks.
Do not expose internal service-authenticated readiness as a human bearer bypass.
Do not rewrite applied historical migrations destructively.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrong role, wrong session surface, missing surface access and unauthenticated state are denied.
Missing profile, wrong workforce kind, suspension/termination and Workforce unavailability fail closed.
Provider-direct and DSH-internal readiness resolve the same Workforce-owned actor truth.
No local fallback fabricates an allowed state when Identity or Workforce truth is unavailable.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused owner fix while preserving exact session-surface and Workforce fail-closed boundaries; never restore a bypass or parallel readiness cache.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U002 access/readiness change set after a reproduced owner-level failure and affected checks pass.

tasks.objective: Close refresh, logout, restart, actor-switch, device and push lifecycle gaps
tasks.currentProblem: SecureStore, device fingerprint and push registration are wired, but concurrent refresh rotation, stale session recovery, logout/relogin, restart and actor switching can still regress protected-state isolation if not tested together.
tasks.requiredChange: Exercise concurrent refresh and client recovery plus native lifecycle tests; fix stale token/session/push/device ownership only at Identity/shared runtime owners and clean any stale local protected data that survives actor transition.
tasks.targetState: Exactly one refresh rotation wins, stale refresh is governed, logout/restart/relogin cannot reveal another Captain, and push/device state follows the current authenticated surface without becoming authorization.
tasks.action: Run Identity concurrency tests and app runtime tests; inspect session store clear/rebind and push registration lifecycle; perform physical-device restart/logout/relogin and actor-switch evidence if any native path changes; search for stale local protected snapshots after the final fix.
mustNotChange: Do not treat device fingerprint as authorization.
Do not log access/refresh tokens or sensitive device identifiers.
Do not convert refresh conflict into a silent second authenticated session.
Do not leave another Captain's protected state cached after actor change.
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent refresh cannot create duplicate valid continuation and loser recovery is explicit.
Logout clears protected session-bound state and relogin binds to the new actor/surface.
Restart restores only a valid current session or fails closed.
Push registration is rebound/revoked consistently with authenticated actor lifecycle.
No known stale session/device/push cleanup defect remains.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused lifecycle change; preserve token rotation, revocation and protected-state cleanup semantics.
tasks.commitBoundary: Keep refresh/session/device/push changes within U002 and rerun the full Captain app test command plus Identity backend suite.
